title: Under Armour Launches New Brand Platform Centered on Commit, Spotlighting the Growth and Rewards Found in Sport

body_markdown:
Under Armour has introduced a new brand platform that brings to life the commitment stories and moments of athletes who keep showing up for the sports they love. The platform reflects Under Armour’s belief that what draws people back to the track, the court, the gym and the field is not only the result, the win or the applause, but the strength, growth, freedom, joy and fulfillment discovered when they truly commit to something they believe in.


In today’s mainstream sports narrative, the spotlight often falls on championships and victories, records and breakthroughs, body goals and social moments. Under Armour, however, is turning its attention to what happens before the outcome: the first breath of cold air at the start of an early run, the instinct to take one more rep after training is over, the courage to get back up after a fall, and the small changes that come from showing up day after day. For Under Armour, commitment is never a decision made in a single moment. It is written into the real stories of choosing to return, and choosing to give oneself fully, again and again.
